title: Pay with x402
author: Exa
claim: First-party POST /search and /contents accept x402 v2 exact USDC on Base and Solana; search from $0.007; settlement paralleled with work; numResults capped at 10.
limitations: Documented 402 example, not a live paid delivery. payTo redacted in docs.

title: x402
author: You.com
claim: First-party search $0.005 and finance research $0.11/$0.50 on Base and Solana USDC; V1 X-PAYMENT unsupported; 402 issued before body validation; no chargebacks; ZDR unavailable on x402.
limitations: Vendor docs. Unpaid GET discovery described; this study did not pay.

title: CoinMarketCap x402
author: CoinMarketCap
claim: First-party GET /x402/* on pro-api.coinmarketcap.com at $0.01 USDC on Base; on-chain transfer only after successful data delivery; production workloads should use Pro API keys.
limitations: Vendor docs; pay-on-success unverified. Pricing may change; parse Payment-Required.

title: x402: Pay-per-Request for Agents
author: Arkham Intelligence
claim: First-party POST https://api.arkm.com/x402; prices = classic credits × $0.20; Base and Solana USDC; failed requests never charged; always POST with JSON body.
limitations: Vendor docs. Unpaid quote curl is documented; paid delivery not verified here.

title: Wallet auth for Alchemy APIs

claim: Alchemy x402 gateway uses SIWE plus USDC x402 on Base to fund an agentic balance, then serves Node/Token/NFT/Prices/Portfolio APIs without an API key.
limitations: Prepaid/top-up model, not pure per-request exact like Exa. Paid flow untested.
